review.summary: I reviewed only the two supplied files: the helper and integration code, and the test file. I found no BLOCKER issues. There is 1 MINOR issue with seal counters: a valid sealed run with more than 10,000 counted items causes a hard error before the existing graceful row-limit result can be returned. There are 3 MINOR issues with fail-closed or window classification: page frame references are not checked when no run exists; window gaps are decided only by when a request was admitted; and the orphan-reference test can pass without the orphan check working. There is 1 NIT about window-gating logic that the final code makes redundant. The changes do not expose raw IDs, run every query in the same transaction, stop with an error when two runs match the same scope, and keep each set of results within the row limit before using it. Coverage status always stays unavailable, so none of these issues can wrongly certify coverage. I did not see test, typecheck or lint results, and an empty BLOCKER/MAJOR list does not mean the tests or release passed.

findings.area: IngressRun schema (Count max) / readIngressSources, IngressRun.parse before the frame limit check
findings.issue: Seal counters are validated with Count = int().max(MAX_VISIT_RECONCILIATION_ROWS), and IngressRun.parse(runs[0]) runs before the frame query and its limit check. A valid sealed run whose frameCount, pageCount or playbackCount is above 10000 therefore fails Zod parsing with an error. It never gets the graceful {status:'unavailable',reason:'limit_exceeded'} result that the frame and intake overflow paths return.
findings.evidence: const Count=z.number().int().min(0).max(MAX_VISIT_RECONCILIATION_ROWS); ... const run=IngressRun.parse(runs[0]); assertIngressRun(...); then frames ... LIMIT MAX+1 → limit_exceeded.
findings.impact: A large but valid run turns the whole visit report into an error instead of the documented limit_exceeded result. The outcome still fails closed, but overflow is handled inconsistently, and seal mismatches above the cap are never reported as mismatches.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate the counters as non-negative safe integers with no cap. After parsing, if any seal counter is above MAX_VISIT_RECONCILIATION_ROWS, return {status:'unavailable',reason:'limit_exceeded'} before running the frame and intake queries.
findings.required_test: A sealed run with frameCount=MAX+1 (and any frames) returns toEqual({status:'unavailable',reason:'limit_exceeded'}) and does not reject.

findings.issue: When no run exists, the helper returns hasGap:false and orphanSources:0 without checking pages whose ingressFrameId is not null. A page that references a frame while no run exists in this scope is a structural contradiction, and it is accepted silently. A composite scoped FK is stated only for playback intake, not for the page ingressFrameId.
findings.evidence: if(!runs.length)return {status:'available',hasGap:false,summary,sources:null}; while the bind() path counts orphanSources and makes them a gap regardless of the report window.
findings.impact: Orphan references are treated as a gap when a run exists but are ignored when no run exists. A page with a dangling or foreign ingressFrameId produces unknown_history instead of evidence_gap.
findings.recommended_fix: In the no-run branch, set summary.orphanSources = pages.filter(p=>p.ingressFrameId!==null).length and hasGap = summary.orphanSources>0.
findings.required_test: With no runs and one page with a non-null ingressFrameId, the result is coverage.reason 'evidence_gap' with sourceIngress {state:'no_run',orphanSources:1}.

findings.issue: Whether a request counts as a gap in the report window depends only on frame.admittedAt being in [startAt,endAt). A frame admitted just before startAt that is still pending, was interrupted, or settled inside the window can still have produced (or lost) a source issued inside the window, because the only rule is source issuedAt ≥ admittedAt. Such frames never mark this window as having a gap.
findings.impact: A report can say unknown_history instead of evidence_gap for a window whose possible sources were lost by a request admitted earlier that overlaps the window. Coverage stays unavailable either way, so impact is limited to how precisely the reason is reported.
findings.recommended_fix: Test for overlap instead: admittedAt < endAt && (settledAt ?? clockAt) >= startAt. For responded frames with a bound source, the source's issuedAt can be used instead.
findings.required_test: A pending frame admitted at startAt-1 (and an interrupted frame settled at startAt+500) makes the report evidence_gap. A frame that both started and settled before startAt does not.

findings.area: 'rejects wrong source kinds, duplicate consumption and foreign/orphan frame references' case 3
findings.issue: The orphan case does not test orphan detection on its own. The responded 200 form frame has no matching source, which already sets missing (an in-window gap), and pageCount:1 against 0 bound pages already sets sealCountMismatch. The test still passes if orphanSources is never counted or never makes hasGap true. None of the cases assert the summary counters.
findings.evidence: [{...boundPage,ingressFrameId:'...0099'}] with [frame] responded/200 and run pageCount:pages.length; the assertion is only toMatchObject({coverage:{reason:'evidence_gap'}}).
findings.impact: A regression in orphan detection, or in the rule that structural contradictions are gaps regardless of window, would go unnoticed.
findings.recommended_fix: For the orphan case, use a frame that is not responded or is outside the window (for example interrupted at 3500), set pageCount:0, and assert sourceIngress {orphanSources:1, missingSources:0, sealCountMismatch:false}. Also assert wrongKindSources:1 in the wrong-kind and duplicate cases.
findings.required_test: The same test, with assertions that isolate each counter.

findings.area: classifyIngressFrames 'wrong' window gating vs the final hasGap expression in readIngressSources
findings.issue: Inside the window check, `wrong` only adds to hasGap for frames in the window. Afterwards, summary.wrongKindSources>0 makes hasGap true for every frame regardless of window, so the window check on `wrong` does nothing and contradicts the comment that structural contradictions ignore the window.
findings.impact: Maintainability only: readers may think wrong-kind sources outside the window are ignored.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove `wrong` from the window-gated condition and leave the global structural check as the only source of truth.
findings.required_test: A wrong-kind source bound to a frame outside the window still returns evidence_gap.
